component.name: Rusted Excel
component.summary: A lightweight desktop spreadsheet for CSV files

description.p: Rusted Excel is a small, fast spreadsheet application for the desktop. A Rust GUI drives a native C/C++ calculation core, with no browser engine, JavaScript runtime or heavyweight toolkit.

It provides a familiar grid with menus, toolbar, formula bar, multiple sheets and a status bar. You can edit with the keyboard, format cells, and use formulas such as =SUM(A1:A10), =AVG(B1:B5) and =IF(A1>0,1,0). Documents are opened and saved as CSV, including quoted fields.
Initial 1.0.0 release of the desktop spreadsheet.
